summary: A snow weather: falling flakes, a white battlefield with churned mud, and snow on roofs, hulls and trees.
rationale: Snow is above all a change of appearance. A wide view over a town in falling snow shows the whole look at once (flakes, white ground and roofs, snowy trees, mountains in the haze); one matched sheet then shows the same town and the same moment of a tank battle under the overcast sky and in snow. The flakes' drift is described in text.

capture.renderer: Forward+ (Vulkan), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090, 1600x900, off-screen window, the user's settings
capture.town: --aivai --seed=3 --mood=overcast / --mood=snow --nohud --focus-struct=town --shot-at=20; overcast from bd4f1b598ae80c6543cd4816e3f49a6ead730876, snow from this branch
capture.note: Each capture scaled to 798x448 and laid out 2x2 with OVERCAST / SNOW labels. The battle can differ slightly run to run. Compatibility renderer checked separately (--rendering-method gl_compatibility with forced vertex shading); not in the sheet.
